title: 修复依赖调度的稳定顺序
issue:
Synthetic development fixture, hand-authored for PatchForge; not an external benchmark.

Repair dependency_order(graph), where graph maps string task names to lists of prerequisite task names. Return every task once, including prerequisite-only names. A task appears only after all prerequisites. Whenever multiple tasks are ready, choose the lexicographically smallest ready task (reconsider the complete ready set after every completion). Duplicate prerequisite names count once. Detect cycles, including disconnected cycles, by raising ValueError. Do not mutate graph or its lists. Empty graph returns []. The current FIFO ready queue violates the lexical policy when a smaller task becomes ready during scheduling.
